page_title: VER 0-0 GEN | Verona v Genoa 13/04/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's the end of the match.
90+3' Ondrej Duda (Verona) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
90+2' Grigoris Kastanos (Verona) leans back and sends a volley soaring over the bar from inside the box. The ball goes out of play and Genoa will have a goal kick.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
89' Patrizio Masini (Genoa) produces an effort from the edge of the box, but doesn't hit the ball properly and sends it yards wide of the left post.
88' Genoa seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
82' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Daniel Mosquera leaves the pitch and Suat Serdar (Verona) comes on.
82' Paolo Zanetti decides to make a substitution. Domagoj Bradaric will be replaced by Martin Frese (Verona).
82' The resulting corner from Ondrej Duda (Verona) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
80' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Morten Thorsby (Genoa) comes onto the pitch for Fabio Miretti.
79' Daniel Mosquera (Verona) latches onto a cross but somehow sends his close-range header high over the bar.
78' The linesman raises his flag. Daniel Mosquera (Verona) is adjudged offside.
77' The corner from Ondrej Duda (Verona) is intercepted by Nicola Leali.
76' 9:4 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.
72' The free kick is taken by Domagoj Bradaric (Verona), but ball is cleared.
70' The resulting corner from Domagoj Bradaric (Verona) is cleared.

70' Verona force a corner. They send men into the box. Grigoris Kastanos (Verona) connects with a cross from the side and steers a header from around the penalty spot towards the goal. The ball goes in the right direction, but it's stopped by one of the defenders.
67' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Domagoj Bradaric (Verona) but poses no threat. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Genoa.
67' Verona take a short corner kick.
65' Here comes a substitution. Antoine Bernede is given a rest as he is replaced by Grigoris Kastanos (Verona).
63' Substitution. Junior Messias (Genoa) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Alessandro Zanoli walks off.
62' Here is a change. Milan Badelj is going off and Patrick Vieira gives the last tactical orders to Jean Onana (Genoa).
62' We are about to witness a subsitution. Caleb Ekuban (Genoa) for Vitinha.

59' Domagoj Bradaric (Verona) is the first to arrive to a rebound inside the penalty area and unleashes a quick low strike towards the middle of the goal that beats the keeper. One of the defenders, however, makes a superb goal-line clearance.
53' Yellow card. Antoine Bernede (Verona) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
52' Great solo effort from Daniel Mosquera (Verona)! He beat a couple of players and shot from the edge of the box, but the effort slips just wide of the right post.

49' Daniel Mosquera (Verona) attempts to find some of his teammates with a dangerous pass from the edge of the box. The opponent's defence, however, intercepts the effort and clears the ball to safety.
46' Half-time substitution. Amin Sarr is replaced by Dailon Rocha Livramento (Verona).
46' The second half gets underway.
45+2' The end of the first half.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.
42' Referee Matteo Marchetti has finally had enough of Paolo Zanetti and brandishes a yellow card at him!
41' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Daniel Mosquera (Verona) was quite harsh and Matteo Marchetti didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
41' Stefano Sabelli (Genoa) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
36' Daniel Mosquera (Verona) receives a slide-rule pass inside the box and has just the keeper to beat. His shot towards the middle of the goal lacks power and Nicola Leali easily makes the save.

36' Vitinha (Genoa) unleashed a monstrous piledriver. He controlled a pass, glanced up at goal and shot from the edge of the box. It could have been a difficult one for the keeper, but the ball fortunately hit one of the defenders and ball bounced away.
34' Ondrej Duda (Verona) takes a mid-range free kick and the effort crashes into the defensive wall.
30' Patrizio Masini (Genoa) has tested the patience of referee Matteo Marchetti and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
29' Stefano Sabelli (Genoa) sends a long ball in, but Lorenzo Montipo comfortably gathers the ball.
27' Alessandro Zanoli (Genoa) picks up a rebound after a melee on the edge of the box. His first-time shot is poor, though, and curls well wide of the right post.
27' Johan Vasquez (Genoa) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
23' Daniele Ghilardi (Verona) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
23' It's a nice effort by Vitinha (Genoa) from the edge of the box, but it's low towards the middle of the goal and straight down the throat of Lorenzo Montipo. Easy save.
22' Verona are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
19' Jackson Tchatchoua (Verona) smashes the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but it goes well wide of the right post.
18' Antoine Bernede (Verona) is penalised for holding. Matteo Marchetti signals a set piece.
16' Ondrej Duda (Verona) gets on the end of a pass and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players.
12' Amin Sarr (Verona) nutmegs the defender on the edge of the box and lashes in a shot at goal that flies well wide of the right post.
12' Koni De Winter (Genoa) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Matteo Marchetti signals.
9' The ball goes out of play and Genoa will have a goal kick. Ondrej Duda (Verona) takes the corner, but he overhits it and none of his teammates are able to reach the ball.
5' Aaron Martin (Genoa) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
1' The match has just started.
The players are on the pitch and Genoa will have the kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Matteo Marchetti.
